description: Can now click into each mechanic on the stats view to see the list of games for each mechanic.
Added download button to the Year in Review page.
Fixed an issue that caused an error when loading the Year in Review for some users.
Fixed an issue when loading collections due to duplicate database entries.
Collections no longer load expansions, to help performance and load times for those with large collections.
Changes to how game data is loaded, should be faster now.
Will now display the name & image of the specific version of a game you own. Apologies for the slow loading of games, the BGG API has been very slow lately.

Sorry for the issues lately. There has been an ongoing problem with the BoardGameGeek API that other developers have also been reporting, where retrieving game data is sometimes corrupt/incomplete. BoardGameGeek have also stated that they are limiting the API to 20 items, so loading game data will take a bit longer now (we used to load 250 at a time). Hoping that only loading 20 games at a time will help with the issue.
Player Count & Best Player Count filter options bumped up from 6 to 9 (thanks for the suggestion!)
Added link to BGG page for games & expansions
Added the Year in Review feature. If you track your plays with BGG, you can view your stats for the year. Available during December & January

We now store your collections for faster load times. If there is a change detected to your collection, or if BGG is busy processing the request, we'll load the last saved version of your collection while the update processes in the background.
